record.question: Which city is known as the 'City of Dreaming Spires'?
record.explanation: Answer B: Oxford. Oxford is the City of Dreaming Spires. The city council identifies its dreaming-spires skyline; Oxford Brookes explains that the phrase derives from Matthew Arnold's Thyrsis. Reference: https://www.oxford.gov.uk/conservation/oxford-views-study; https://www.brookes.ac.uk/library/about/gateway-to-oxford. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
